title: Legacy codegen is NOT dead — it generates all library IR
content: The "legacy" LLVMIRGen path (~49K lines) is misleadingly named. It generates ALL standard library function implementations in every build. The MIR path (~3K lines) handles only user code. True elimination of the legacy path requires MIR to also handle: library IR generation, debug info, coverage instrumentation, and async codegen. Any investment in "fixing legacy" should be weighed against closing MIR gaps instead.
